title: senna leandrii
intro: Senna leandrii, commonly known as the Madagascar senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to aid in digestion and relieve constipation due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna leandrii include purgation, which involves the promotion of bowel movements, and it also exhibits anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids and alkaloids.
